name: Omarchy Light Control for Hue
author: Sven Wagener
description: Control Philips Hue lights from the Omarchy bar: rooms, zones, scenes, colors, color temperature, single lamps and smart plugs, with live updates. Talks to the Hue bridge on your local network; no cloud, nothing to build or install.
